              ∃ Heq : 8%N = n', ∀ vmem : bv n', ⌜values !! i = Some vmem⌝ -∗ ⌜eq_rect 8%N bv n1 n' Heq = vmem⌝ -∗ a' ↦ₘ∗ values -∗ WPasm HIDDEN)%I
          else
           (⌜n' = 8%N⌝ ∗
            ∃ i : nat, ⌜i = bv_unsigned (Z_to_bv 64 (decodeItemInputPointer args)) - a'⌝ ∗ ⌜(i + N.to_nat 1 <= length values)%nat⌝ ∗
              ∀ vmem : bv 8, ⌜vmem = Z_to_bv 8 (little_endian_to_bv n' (take (N.to_nat 1) (drop i values)))⌝ -∗ ⌜n1 = vmem⌝ -∗ a' ↦ₘ∗ values -∗ WPasm HIDDEN)%I

      end))
